We're not making new metal, we're making metal new.

We're reimagining metal recycling with a planet-positive approach – giving humanity the tools to usher in a new age of metal manufacturing that will deliver local, sustainable, and cost-effective solutions. Sun Metalon's innovative spirit is fueled by a vision of the future where humankind thrives on Earth and beyond. It's something we're calling our "Mars Shot." Kazuhiko Nishioka, our CEO, explains.

Over the past several thousand years, the advancement of humankind has been intertwined with advancements in metal manufacturing. However, our evolved relationship with metal has now become a burden on our planet.

To reduce the environmental impact of our mass-consumption society, the metal manufacturing industry must undergo a revolution. Not small changes, but changes that fundamentally overturn conventional wisdom.
